overview: Helps the game choose which story room layout appears as the player moves through the story.
description: Per-condition weighted candidate lists for the story-room placement chosen from demo progress.

ID.simple: Which point in the player's story progress makes this room choice apply. The game bases it on how far the player has advanced.
ID.technical: The export column ID is the native FName Id at row +0x08 and the DataTable import key; FindRow matches the external row key in StoryRoomConditionDataTables (DTM +0x860), taking the first loaded table that contains it. Story_PickRoomPlacement_13097C0 derives that key from demo progress: default ROOM_COND_0000, the last cleared demo's non-None StoryDemo.Id_StoryRoomCondition while the ChapterIndex-6 chapter has a pending demo, or a uniform pick of all chapters' non-None demo conditions when bPickWhenAllCleared is true. The 67 exported keys are noncontiguous ROOM_COND_0000..0086 (20 gaps); each is referenced by exactly one StoryDemo row, and every non-None StoryDemo.Id_StoryRoomCondition resolves. A missing condition row returns NAME_None.

Id_StoryRoomPlacement.simple: Which story room layout can appear for this condition. Right now each condition offers just one choice.
Id_StoryRoomPlacement.technical: TArray<FName> (row +0x10) with eight slots in every export; index 0 is a non-None ROOM_* id in all 67 rows and indices 1-7 are None. The picker collects only the prefix before the first None (None is the terminator), returns NAME_None when that prefix is empty, and returns the selected prefix entry; a missing condition row also returns NAME_None. Callers cache the result in GameManager.StudioStoryRoomPlacementId_D18 (+0xD18, initially NAME_None), copy it to FStudioPhaseRequest.Name5C (+0x5C), resolve it through StoryRoomPlacementDataTables (+0x850), and then to map levels and room actors. All 67 ids resolve and each exported placement row is named exactly once.

Weights.simple: How likely each listed room layout is to be chosen. A bigger number gives that layout more chances, though only one layout is offered.
Weights.technical: TArray<float> (row +0x20) parallel by index to Id_StoryRoomPlacement. The picker copies Weights[i] only for the non-None candidate prefix, returns NAME_None for an empty prefix, sums those floats, sets roll = StoryFRand() * total (StoryFRand is RandRange(0, MAX_int32) * 2^-32), then uses the first index where roll < Weights[i] after earlier weights are subtracted; otherwise it falls back to the last prefix index. Weights[i] has no independent bounds check, so the arrays must stay aligned and a shorter Weights array is out-of-bounds. Every exported row has eight 1.0 weights, but only index 0 is a candidate, so the supplied data deterministically selects that one placement rather than making an eight-way uniform draw.

notes: The condition row is chosen from save state before this table is read. The picker uses the StoryChapter row with ChapterIndex 6 (CHAP_0006 in the export) and treats a listed demo as pending when its state is <2; only ids ending in M matter there because the selected chapter is not CHAP_0007. It then scans all chapters and keeps the last cleared (state >=2) demo's non-None condition, defaulting to ROOM_COND_0000. With no pending demo, bPickWhenAllCleared=true picks a uniform index over all chapters' non-None demo conditions (RandRange(0, Num-1), with no de-duplication), while false reuses cached StudioStoryRoomPlacementId_D18, which starts as NAME_None. The reconstructed picker does not null-check the chapter lookup before reading its demo list (Source/Abrams/Private/StoryLaunchHelpers.cpp:211-290; Source/Abrams/Private/GameManager.cpp:142).

CHAP_0007 is a separate ChapterIndex 7 row in the export, so the picker's extra 'any pending demo in CHAP_0007' test is not reached with the supplied data; it would apply only if the ChapterIndex-6 lookup resolved to CHAP_0007 (Source/Abrams/Private/StoryLaunchHelpers.cpp:222-238).

Direct picker calls pass true in Story_ResolveDemoLaunch, MainMenuTop, StoryDemoPreBattle, StoryDemoPostBattle, StoryDemoShortStory and BattleStory's win/restart paths; false is used for BattleStory back/quit, Credits, StoryCharacterSelect and StoryDemoBase retry/back (BattleStory's loss path passes EndRequest != 4, hence true). Each call writes the result to GameManager+0xD18 and copies it to FStudioPhaseRequest.Name5C before requesting the placement's levels.
row constructor is empty; no default candidate or weight is inserted in C++ (Source/AbramsDataTable/Private/GameDataTableRow_StoryRoomCondition.cpp:3).

The sole export has 67 unique keys from ROOM_COND_0000 to ROOM_COND_0086 with 20 gaps (0018-0020, 0027, 0040-0043, 0056-0058, 0065, 0067-0070, 0073, 0076, 0079, 0085). Every row has eight placement slots and eight 1.0 weights, but exactly one non-None placement at index 0 pointing at the same-number ROOM_* row; no numbered shards or locale variants were found in the export set.

The only loader name is StoryRoomConditionDataTable: GameDataTableManager_ResolveLoadedTable obtains the UDataTable from AbramsAssetManager and AddLoadedDataTables null-filters it into StoryRoomConditionDataTables at DTM+0x860; StoryFindRowInline returns the first loaded table containing the condition key, so duplicate keys across tables would shadow later rows (Source/Abrams/Private/GameDataTableManager.cpp:146-166,264,437; Source/Abrams/Private/StoryLaunchHelpers.cpp:136,293).

Runtime descriptions come from reconstructed C++ plus uncooked exports. status/ marks Story_PickRoomPlacement (0x13097c0) and Story_GetRoomPlacementLevels (0x130a010) behavioural-certified rather than byte-matched, while StoryFRand (0xe0afb0) is byte-matched. No retail Blueprint graphs, live runtime capture, complete Content tree or exhaustive asset/Blueprint reference scan was available, so Blueprint overrides and actual loaded level actors are not independently verified.

usages.detail: Loads the sole StoryRoomConditionDataTable into StoryRoomConditionDataTables (DTM +0x860).
Story_PickRoomPlacement derives a condition from demo state, looks up its row here, and returns a weighted placement id or NAME_None.
Selects the ChapterIndex-6 chapter and checks pending main demos; scans all chapters for the last cleared demo's condition or the all-cleared random condition.
First-match condition-row lookup and the weighted draw over the non-None placement prefix.
Story_GetRoomPlacementLevels resolves the chosen placement to Map.FileName entries plus LevelDesignName, returning empty when either row is missing.
Story_ResolveDemoLaunch caches the picked placement and copies it to FStudioPhaseRequest.Name5C before requesting levels.
Prepare state uses StudioIncomingRequest_28.Name5C to find the StoryRoomPlacement row that drives map lighting, character spawns and the tagged camera.
Battle-to-room transitions repick with false or true and request MainMenuStory with the cached placement and its levels.
Top-menu story launch also caches a picked placement id and passes it through the phase request.
